instruction: Fix `binary_search` in `seqops/search.py` so it returns -1 when the target is not present in the sorted list. It currently returns the loop variable as if it were an insertion index, so every missing target yields a non-negative index instead of -1.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/seqops/search.py b/seqops/search.py
--- a/seqops/search.py
+++ b/seqops/search.py
@@ -16,4 +16,4 @@
             lo = mid + 1
         else:
             hi = mid - 1
-    return lo
+    return -1
